protocol: AmberClaw Honest Onboarding and Run Workspace Pilot
prerequisites: Python 3.11+ installed, git installed, modern web browser
target_success_criteria: >= 8 / 10 participants complete first authenticated run and artifact inspection unaided within 15 minutes

participant_records.notes: Followed CLI startup and completed web login immediately.
Configured OPENAI_API_KEY as flagged by readiness banner.
Verified local Ollama detected; inspected sample artifacts.
Used keyboard navigation exclusively; praised focus indicator visibility.
Triggered run cancellation test; state correctly showed failed.
Inspected generated incident markdown in workspace artifacts tab.
Fastest participant; confirmed zero fabricated service greenlights.
Noticed degraded status due to missing model key; added key and status updated to ready.
Needed clarification on host port binding when Ollama was run in separate container.
Validated run recovery endpoint when simulated process terminated.
